test_parse_version: test the _parse_version function to parse version strings into normalized tuple representations
test_check_version: test the check_version function to validate package version specs against installed versions
test_check_version_invalid_spec: test that check_version raises ValueError for invalid version specification strings
test_check_version_fallback_to_dunder_ve: test that check_version falls back to __version__ when importlib.metadata lookup fails
test_check_version_package_not_found: test that check_version raises PackageNotFoundError when both metadata and module lookups fail
